subject: Twisted squid
topic: Eight hundred fifty meters down in the Gulf of Mexico, scientists found something they couldn't explain.
script:
Eight hundred fifty meters down in the Gulf of Mexico, scientists found something they couldn't explain.
It was a squid, but it didn't look like one.
Its arms were folded back so far that it had lost its squid shape completely.
NOAA's squid expert called it probably the most bizarre squid he had ever seen.
Its long tentacles were missing, and it was clearly injured.
People watching the live stream were stumped.
The best guess was a disc squid, a species that had never been seen alive.
So no one could say for sure what it really was.
What do you think it was?
